ci_wiring.change: Added an unconditional 'BFF test architecture gate' step running 'python3 -m pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_test_architecture.py', plus 'python3 -m pip install httpx' in the existing 'Install deps (best-effort)' step.
ci_wiring.why_unconditional: Placed before the tooling/product boundary classification step so it runs on every PR touching this repo, matching the task's acceptance that new main imports anywhere (not just tooling- or product-classified diffs) must be caught.
ci_wiring.why_httpx_install: services/control-plane/bff/tests/conftest.py (loaded by pytest for any collection under that directory) imports httpx for its asgi_request fixture. httpx is declared in services/control-plane/bff/requirements.txt but the Smoke acceptance job only installs the repo-root requirements.txt plus a small explicit tooling dependency set (cryptography, pyyaml, pydantic, pytest) -- it does not otherwise exercise BFF runtime deps. Without this one-line addition, collection of test_bff_test_architecture.py would fail on ModuleNotFoundError: httpx in a fresh CI runner, even though the gate test module itself only needs ast/json/pytest from the standard library.
ci_wiring.why_no_branch_protection_change: smoke is already one of the 3 required status checks (Commit trailers / Runtime mirror guard / Smoke acceptance); adding a step inside an already-required job does not require a branch protection change.
